title: Palettable
description: Adds an in-game color gradient creator, aimed at making building more relaxing and digestible.
body:
**Palettable** adds a new menu to help builders in either modded or vanilla. Bound by default to '**P**', the Palette Creator menu helps create block palettes and gradients using any blocks in your world, even modded ones! 

To get started, select block **A** and **B** from the search bar or your hotbar to find all the colors inbetween. 

- **Thresh** controls how similar in color a block must be to appear
- **Max** controls the amount of blocks in the pallete

Adjust settings to fine-tune your palette and save it for later use!
